calls.statement:
SELECT fs.week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (fs.store_key, fs.product_key)) AS dist_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus,
 SUM(fs.closing_value) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, MAX(fs.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'cat' AS k, category AS a, COUNT(*) AS n, NULL AS b FROM dim_product GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR)||' '||cs.store_name||' cur='||cs.is_current||' close='||COALESCE(CAST(cs.close_date AS VARCHAR),''), COUNT(*), SUM(fs.closing_value)
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating' AND (s.store_id>=129 AND s.store_id<=140 OR s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id=125)
GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units IS NULL OR fs.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
 SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(fs.closing_value - fs.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_mismatch,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.category<>'Paint & Decorating' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aswas_differs,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL AND p.delisted_on<fs.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delisted_with_stock,
 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS keys_out_of_validity,
 MAX(fs.closing_units) AS maxunits, MAX(fs.closing_value) AS maxval, SUM(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_units
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.category='Paint & Decorating'
